title: Publication-Quality ggplot2 Themes
text: package provides dynamic color fill aesthetic scale helpers evaluate aesthetics late provide automatic colour fill properties. features blend scales (scale_blend) automatically compute complementary outline fill, well contrast helpers (aes_fill_contrast(discrete = “none”) aes_panel_contrast(discrete = “none”)) adaptively select light dark colours based fill set panel background. recommended use ggrefine function, followed ggplot2::aes, change colour/fill palettes using update_palette. ensures functions work situations.
code: update_palette(discrete = jumble::jumble)  penguins |>   tidyr::drop_na() |>   dplyr::count(species, sex) |>   ggrefine() +   aes(x = sex, y = n, fill = species, label = n) +   geom_col(width = 0.5, position = position_dodge2()) +   scale_y_zero(name = NULL, labels = NULL) +    scale_fill_blend_discrete(name = NULL) +   geom_text(     aes_fill_contrast(discrete = "none"),      position = position_dodge2(width = 0.5),      vjust = 1.33,   ) +   refine_axis_grid(discrete = "x") update_palette(discrete = scales::pal_hue()) update_panel_size(heights = NULL, widths = NULL)

what: Refine plot axes and panel grid — refine_axis_grid
title: Refine plot axes and panel grid — refine_axis_grid
text: single entry point axis_mode x grid_mode combinations previously exposed sixteen separate refine_*_*() functions. functions still exist internally (e.g. .refine_modern_drift()) actual work; function just dispatches right one.

title: Refine plot axes and panel grid — refine_axis_grid
code: refine_axis_grid(   discrete,   orientation = NULL,   axis_mode = "modern",   grid_mode = "drift" )

title: Refine plot axes and panel grid — refine_axis_grid
text: discrete Character. axes treated discrete refinement purposes: "none", "x", "y", "". Required. orientation Character. primary axis interest: "x" "y". Affects grid_mode values "drift" "flow". NULL (default), inferred discrete: "y" gives "y", otherwise "x". axis_mode Character. One "classic", "modern", "minimal", "void". Default "modern". grid_mode Character. One "keep", "drift", "flow", "drop". Default "drift".

title: Refine plot axes and panel grid — refine_axis_grid
text: ggplot2 theme object.

title: Refine plot axes and panel grid — refine_axis_grid
text: axis_mode controls happens axis lines, ticks, text, titles: classic Removes ticks discrete axes . modern Like classic, plus removes axis line ticks non-orientation axis. minimal Removes axis lines ticks, regardless orientation discreteness. void Like minimal, plus removes axis text titles. grid_mode controls happens panel gridlines: keep Leaves panel gridlines unchanged. drift Removes gridlines orientation axis, least one axis discrete. flow Removes gridlines orientation axis unconditionally. drop Removes panel gridlines.
